crossRefs.note: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but…
There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.
The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.
